sentences.text: You’ve now covered every rule in the Rules of the Road module.
Here’s how to turn that into a passing score.
Drill the lights, shapes and sound signals every day with the flashcards in this app, because they’re pure memorization.
Retake each lesson check until you score one hundred percent.
Then take the Rules of the Road quiz until you score at least ninety percent twice in a row.
Finally, the week before your exam, read the rules once more in the Coast Guard handbook, side by side, paying special attention to the Inland differences.
